Indicative measurement, not a medical device. For prescription lenses rely on the measurement taken by your optician.
%1$s: %2$s mm (mono R %3$s / L %4$s mm), measured with PD Measure

The app finds pupils and irises with an on-device face landmark model. The distance between the pupils in pixels is converted to millimetres using a reference of known size: the iris diameter (11.7 mm on average, or your calibrated value) or the width of a standard card (85.60 mm). Since your eyes converge on the camera, the near PD is converted to distance PD using the estimated camera distance.
The app has no internet permission. Camera frames are analysed in memory and never saved or sent anywhere.
